name: Recraft
label: Recraft
description: Official Recraft image/vector REST at https://external.api.recraft.ai. generate is synchronous (POST /v1/images/generations). vectorize converts raster to SVG. style creates a reusable style id. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key as Authorization Bearer. Image payloads use type file. Docs: https://www.recraft.ai/docs/api-reference/endpoints. Terms: https://www.recraft.ai/terms. Never log api_key. No official get-task poll path as of 2026-08-20.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: generate requires prompt. vectorize: file (type file) or image_url. style: image_urls and/or file1 (type file) plus style. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"prompt":"two race cars on a track","model":"recraftv4_1"}.

schema.label: prompt
schema.description: Required for generate. Max length depends on model (see Recraft appendix).

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for vectorize (PNG/JPG/WEBP, max 10MB, max 16MP). Never inline bytes. JSON path also accepts image_url.

schema.label: image_url
schema.description: HTTPS or data URL for vectorize when not sending file. Recraft fetches this URL.

schema.label: style_id
schema.description: UUID from operation=style to reuse as visual reference on generate.

schema.label: style
schema.description: Request-body parameter `style` for operations: generate, style.

schema.label: response_format
schema.description: Request-body parameter `response_format` for operations: generate, vectorize.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (data[].url or image.url or style id). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. generate: data[].url (or b64_json). vectorize: image.url. style: id.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: EXACT: generate | vectorize | style. Default generate = POST /v1/images/generations (sync; no poll endpoint in official docs).

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Recraft API token from https://app.recraft.ai/profile/api. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Default generate model id. Official default recraftv4_1 (https://www.recraft.ai/docs/api-reference/endpoints). Current ids: recraftv4_1, recraftv4_1_vector, recraftv4_1_pro, recraftv4_1_pro_vector, recraftv4_1_utility, recraftv4_1_utility_vector, recraftv4_1_utility_pro, recraftv4_1_utility_pro_vector, recraftv4, recraftv4_vector, recraftv4_pro, recraftv4_pro_vector, recraftv3, recraftv3_vector, recraftv2, recraftv2_vector. Put model on INPUT to send it (handler reads body from input).
